intro: The honeypot caught something at 03:14. It was not an attacker. It was a message, split across every protocol the intruder could find.
echo: Leave something sweet out, and watch who comes to take it.

puzzles.title: Null Byte
puzzles.flavor: Shredded, then sorted by a very tidy intern.

partials.ec6943fbd6b8784057f7883dc319c3184de3c936: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: The strips are alphabetised, not in order. The word lengths say where the breaks fall. Which strip could start the sentence?

puzzles.title: Air Gap
puzzles.flavor: Two directions at a time, and never a destination.

partials.ec8f4db08fc25ba0dcc83836d9ae5092bf1d572e: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Imagine each of these as a person holding two flags out at arm's length. Sailors had an alphabet for that.

puzzles.title: Cold Boot
puzzles.flavor: Fences and corners; some have an animal inside. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

partials.3ee066e40d7d306b1810910fe677a0f47376fdc4: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.
partials.589da8cf13bce478f80c48f0039dac5f9cb2c89f: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Picture the alphabet written into a couple of #-grids and X-grids. Which cell would each shape be? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Heap Spray
puzzles.flavor: The spaces, at least, are honest.

puzzles.title: Rainbow Table
puzzles.flavor: Nothing is missing. Nothing is where it was.

puzzles.title: Rubber Ducky
puzzles.flavor: Every answer is small, and none is bigger than it needs to be.

items: Suits in a deck of cards
Pawns on a chessboard at the start of a game
Red balls racked at the start of a snooker frame

puzzles.title: Dead Drop
puzzles.flavor: Dressed overall, and saying far more than hello. Something in here has been through the looking glass.

hints: Ships carry a flag for every letter of the alphabet. Do you know them? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Man In The Middle
puzzles.flavor: Heard over the radio from the other side of the glass.

partials.4e508baadb04c2213d3ebd08c318302d8c06bff7: Nearly. There's a stowaway aboard: one letter too many. Put it ashore, but remember who it was.

hints: Each word stands for a letter, the way radio operators spell. Do those letters read? If not, try the alphabet backwards.

meta.title: Meta: Capture The Flag
meta.flavor: Everything arrived a little heavier than it left.
hints: Did every answer come out the right size the first time? Each had one letter too many. Did you keep them?
